S11 E84 — Show Me Your Kitties
A Maine Coon cat breeder promised the same kitten to two families; to make it right, she offered to find the plaintiffs a similar cat from a different breeder, but they now say the replacement kitten was sick.

title: Hot Bench
description:
S11 E54 — The Flames of Discord
A woman who discovered that her new roommate wanted a live-in caregiver says the position was immediately too demanding, and she was barred from getting her belongings after move-out; the resident countersues, saying the woman set fire to her garage.

title: Judge Mathis
description:
S20 E76
The plaintiff suspects that the defendant may be her biological granddaughter, so she has petitioned the court for a DNA test to find out the truth.

title: Adam's Law
description:
S01 E39 — Pepper Sprayed Through the Vents
A leasing-office dispute explodes into a courtroom battle when a woman claims her tenant pepper-sprayed her car vents, keyed her bumper and threatened her.
